sections.title: FDA Forms
sections.description: FDA Form 1571 (IND Application), Form 1572 (Investigator Statement), Form 3674 (Certification of Compliance).

sections.title: Form FDA 1571
sections.description: Investigational New Drug Application form — identifies sponsor, drug, IND number.

sections.title: Form FDA 1572
sections.description: Statement of Investigator — each clinical investigator must sign.

sections.title: Form FDA 3674
sections.description: Certification of Compliance with ClinicalTrials.gov requirements.

sections.title: Cover Letter
sections.description: Cover letter introducing the IND, summarizing contents, and highlighting key points for the FDA reviewer.

sections.title: Administrative Information
sections.description: Contact information, agent designation, transfer statements.

sections.title: Contact/Agent Information
sections.description: Sponsor contact and authorized US agent.

sections.title: Field Copy Certification
sections.description: Certification for field copy of IND.

sections.title: Debarment Certification
sections.description: Certification that no debarred persons are involved.

sections.title: Financial Certification and Disclosure (Forms FDA 3454 / 3455)
sections.description: Certification (Form FDA 3454) and/or disclosure (Form FDA 3455) of clinical-investigator financial interests and arrangements. FDA files these under heading 1.3.4, not under the 1.1 forms heading.
sections.regulatoryRef: 21 CFR 54; FDA eCTD Module 1 Specification v2.3 §1.3.4

sections.title: References
sections.description: Letters of authorization, right of reference, cross-references to other INDs/NDAs.

sections.title: Letter of Authorization
sections.description: Authorization to reference another IND or DMF.

sections.title: Statement of Right of Reference
sections.description: Statement granting right of reference to supporting data.

sections.title: Other Correspondence
sections.description: Pre-IND correspondence, requests and waivers, and the environmental analysis — FDA heading 1.12.

sections.title: Pre-IND Correspondence
sections.description: Pre-IND meeting request, briefing package and FDA written responses carried into the IND.
sections.regulatoryRef: 21 CFR 312.82; FDA eCTD Module 1 Specification v2.3 §1.12.1

sections.title: Environmental Assessment or Claim of Categorical Exclusion
sections.description: Environmental assessment per NEPA or claim of categorical exclusion under 21 CFR 25.31(e). FDA files it at heading 1.12.14.
sections.regulatoryRef: 21 CFR 25.31; FDA eCTD Module 1 Specification v2.3 §1.12.14 (environmental analysis)

sections.title: Labeling
sections.description: Investigational drug labeling and the Investigator's Brochure — FDA files both under the 1.14 labeling heading (1.14.4).
sections.regulatoryRef: 21 CFR 312.23(a)(7)(iv)(d); FDA eCTD Module 1 Specification v2.3 §1.14

sections.title: Investigator's Brochure
sections.description: Investigator's Brochure containing nonclinical and clinical data available to investigators. FDA files it at heading 1.14.4.1.
sections.regulatoryRef: 21 CFR 312.23(a)(5); FDA eCTD Module 1 Specification v2.3 §1.14.4.1 (investigator brochure)

sections.title: Investigational Drug Labeling
sections.description: Copies of all labels and labeling to be provided to each investigator, carrying the 21 CFR 312.6 investigational-use caution statement.
sections.regulatoryRef: 21 CFR 312.6; 21 CFR 312.23(a)(7)(iv)(d); FDA eCTD Module 1 Specification v2.3 §1.14.4.2

sections.title: Introductory Statement and General Investigational Plan
sections.description: Name of drug, active ingredients, pharmacological class, structural formula, dosage form and route, broad objectives and planned duration; plus the rationale, indication(s), approach, studies planned for the ensuing year, expected subject numbers and anticipated risks. One document, filed at FDA heading 1.20.
sections.regulatoryRef: 21 CFR 312.23(a)(3); FDA eCTD Module 1 Specification v2.3 §1.20 (general investigational plan for initial IND)

sections.title: Nonclinical Overview
sections.description: Integrated overview of nonclinical evaluation strategy and findings.

sections.title: Clinical Overview
sections.description: Critical assessment of clinical data (typically for NDA; optional for initial IND).

sections.title: Nonclinical Written and Tabulated Summaries
sections.description: Written summaries of pharmacology, PK, and toxicology plus tabulated summaries.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.description: Overview of nonclinical testing strategy.

sections.title: Pharmacology Written Summary
sections.description: Primary and secondary pharmacodynamics, safety pharmacology.

sections.title: Pharmacology Tabulated Summary
sections.description: Tabulated pharmacology study results.

sections.title: Pharmacokinetics Written Summary
sections.description: Absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion summary.

sections.title: Pharmacokinetics Tabulated Summary
sections.description: Tabulated PK study results.

sections.title: Toxicology Written Summary
sections.description: Single/repeat dose, genotoxicity, carcinogenicity, reproductive toxicity summaries.

sections.title: Toxicology Tabulated Summary
sections.description: Tabulated toxicology study results.

sections.title: Clinical Summary
sections.description: Clinical summary including biopharmaceutics, clinical pharmacology, efficacy, safety (typically NDA; limited for initial IND).

sections.title: Drug Substance
sections.description: Full drug substance CMC data.

sections.title: General Information
sections.description: Nomenclature, structure, general properties of the drug substance.

sections.title: Manufacture
sections.description: Manufacturer info, description of process. Process flow diagram, controls, equipment.

sections.title: Characterization
sections.description: Structural elucidation, impurity characterization.

sections.title: Control of Drug Substance
sections.description: Specifications, analytical procedures, validation, batch analyses, justification.

sections.title: Reference Standards
sections.description: Reference standards or materials used for testing.

sections.title: Container Closure System
sections.description: Container closure system for drug substance storage.

sections.title: Stability
sections.description: Stability summary, post-approval stability protocol, stability data.

sections.title: Drug Product
sections.description: Full drug product CMC data.

sections.title: Description and Composition
sections.description: Dosage form description, composition including overages, formulation development.

sections.title: Pharmaceutical Development
sections.description: Formulation development, manufacturing process development, container closure selection.

sections.title: Manufacture
sections.description: Manufacturers, batch formula, manufacturing process flow, in-process controls.

sections.title: Control of Excipients
sections.description: Excipient specifications, analytical procedures, human/animal origin excipients.

sections.title: Control of Drug Product
sections.description: Specifications, analytical procedures, validation, batch analyses.

sections.title: Reference Standards
sections.description: Reference standards for drug product testing.

sections.title: Container Closure System
sections.description: Description and suitability of primary packaging for drug product.

sections.title: Stability
sections.description: Drug product stability summary, protocols, accelerated and long-term data.

sections.title: Appendices
sections.description: Facilities and equipment, adventitious agents, novel excipients.

sections.title: Regional Information
sections.description: FDA-specific regional CMC information.

sections.title: Pharmacology
sections.description: Primary/secondary pharmacodynamics and safety pharmacology study reports.

sections.title: Primary Pharmacodynamics
sections.description: Studies on mode of action/effects related to desired therapeutic target.

sections.title: Secondary Pharmacodynamics
sections.description: Studies on effects unrelated to desired therapeutic target.

sections.title: Safety Pharmacology
sections.description: Core battery: cardiovascular, CNS, respiratory safety studies.

sections.title: Pharmacodynamic Drug Interactions
sections.description: Nonclinical pharmacodynamic drug interaction studies.

sections.title: Pharmacokinetics
sections.description: ADME study reports, analytical methods, and PK drug interactions.

sections.title: Analytical Methods and Validation
sections.description: Bioanalytical method validation for nonclinical PK studies.

sections.title: Absorption
sections.description: Absorption studies in animal species.

sections.title: Distribution
sections.description: Tissue distribution, plasma protein binding, whole-body autoradiography.

sections.title: Metabolism
sections.description: In vitro and in vivo metabolism, metabolite identification.

sections.title: Excretion
sections.description: Urinary, fecal, biliary excretion studies.

sections.title: Pharmacokinetic Drug Interactions
sections.description: In vitro CYP inhibition/induction and transporter studies.

sections.title: Toxicology
sections.description: Complete toxicology study reports: acute, repeat-dose, genotoxicity, reproductive, special.

sections.title: Single-Dose Toxicity
sections.description: Acute toxicity studies in rodent and non-rodent species.

sections.title: Repeat-Dose Toxicity
sections.description: Sub-acute and chronic repeat-dose toxicity studies (28-day, 90-day minimum for Phase I).

sections.title: Genotoxicity
sections.description: Standard battery: Ames test, in vitro chromosomal aberration, in vivo micronucleus.

sections.title: Carcinogenicity
sections.description: Carcinogenicity studies (typically not required for initial IND).

sections.title: Reproductive and Developmental Toxicity
sections.description: Fertility, embryo-fetal development, pre/postnatal development studies.

sections.title: Local Tolerance
sections.description: Local tolerance studies (for non-oral or injection routes).

sections.title: Other Toxicity Studies
sections.description: Immunotoxicity, juvenile toxicity, phototoxicity, dependence studies as applicable.

sections.title: Reports of Biopharmaceutic Studies
sections.description: Bioavailability, bioequivalence, in vitro-in vivo correlation studies.

sections.title: Reports of Studies Pertinent to Pharmacokinetics Using Human Biomaterials
sections.description: Plasma protein binding, hepatic metabolism, metabolite profiling in human tissues.

sections.title: Reports of Human PK Studies
sections.description: Healthy volunteer PK, food effect, drug interaction, renal/hepatic impairment PK studies.

sections.title: Reports of Human Pharmacodynamic Studies
sections.description: Mechanism of action studies in humans, PK/PD modeling.

sections.title: Reports of Efficacy and Safety Studies
sections.description: For initial IND: the Phase 1 clinical protocol. For amendments: study reports as they become available.

sections.title: Clinical Study Reports of Controlled Studies
sections.description: Full clinical study reports per ICH E3 format.

sections.title: Clinical Study Reports of Uncontrolled Studies
sections.description: Open-label, single-arm, or observational study reports.

sections.title: Reports of Analyses of Data from More than One Study
sections.description: Integrated summaries, pooled analyses, meta-analyses.

sections.title: Other Study Reports — Previous Human Experience
sections.description: Previous human experience with the drug (marketing or investigation outside the US, withdrawals for safety or effectiveness) as study reports, summarised in 2.5. Clinical content — not a Module 1 heading in FDA eCTD.

sections.title: Reports of Post-Marketing Experience
sections.description: Post-marketing experience from other countries (if drug is marketed elsewhere).

sections.title: Case Report Forms and Individual Patient Listings
sections.description: Blank CRFs and individual patient data listings for clinical studies.

sections.title: Literature References
sections.description: Published literature used to support the clinical section.
